name: Colleen B. Rozatti
office: City of West Covina, City Treasurer

items.text: Colleen B. Rozatti is the City Treasurer of West Covina, reelected in 2022. She serves as an ex officio non-voting member of the city’s Audit Committee. During her 2013 campaign, the former bank employee promised an easier-to-read budget and more communication with the public about city finances.
